description:
Folded into fz-k22.23 before implementation because the producer-scoped member-set repair depends on and completes the uncommitted fz-k22.23 carrier model; neither can be verified green independently.

Retained discovery
A single callable construction can have several specialized target members sharing CallableId and one capture surface. This differs from BackendCallableDispatchSet, a callsite analysis union that can combine distinct values/environments. fz-k22.23 must carry a producer-scoped member set through transport construction and materialize one boxed callable boundary which dispatches among those validated members.

Signal
compiler2_jit_runs_range_reduce2_first_acc_bridge_from_native_artifacts pins Entry1's RawAtom state ABI then invokes the same closure under Entry2's accumulator shape and aborts in fz_unbox_atom.

Closure condition
Close this ticket as folded when fz-k22.23 lands the coherent carrier/member-set change and passes the range JIT regression.
title: Represent multi-specialization members on one callable value
